children.text: Rain Bird R-VAN-24 — многопоточна ротаторна дюза

Диапазон на радиуса: 5,2–7,3 m.
Форма на поливане: регулируем сектор 45°–270°.
Многопоточните струи създават по-едри капки, които се отклоняват по-малко при лек вятър.
Съгласуваната норма на валеж улеснява подбора на различни модели в една система.

Rain Bird R-VAN-24 is a rotary nozzle designed to deliver controlled, water-efficient irrigation for landscaped areas. Multiple rotating streams apply water more slowly than many conventional spray nozzles, helping the soil absorb it and reducing runoff when the system is correctly designed. The stated coverage is 5.2–7.3 m; the watering pattern is 45–270°; recommended operating pressure is 2.1–3.8 bar.

R-VAN nozzles are useful for matching irrigation coverage to the shape of the planting area, including standard arcs and narrow strips. Actual radius and uniformity depend on pressure, spacing, soil and wind conditions.

children.text: Rain Bird R-VAN-24 — multi-stream rotary nozzle

Rain Bird R-VAN-24 produces multiple rotating streams for even lawn irrigation. Larger droplets hold their trajectory better in light wind, while matched precipitation makes it easier to combine models from the series.
Practical benefits
Radius range: 5.2–7.3 m.
Pattern: adjustable 45°–270° arc.
Multiple rotating streams create larger droplets that are less affected by light wind.
Matched precipitation makes it easier to combine different models in one system.
Adjustment, pressure and compatibility

Adjust the radius and arc by hand while the system is running; no special tool is required. To flush the nozzle, pull it upwards as directed by the manufacturer. Operating pressure: 2.1–3.8 bar; recommended: 3.1 bar. For best results, use a Rain Bird PRS45 pressure-regulated spray body.
Technical specifications
Model: R-VAN-24; series: R-VAN.
Radius range: 5.2–7.3 m.
Arc/pattern: adjustable 45°–270° arc; operating pressure: 2.1–3.8 bar; recommended: 3.1 bar.

At the recommended pressure of 3.1 bar, the radius is 7.0 m and flow is 1.59–9.54 l/min depending on the selected arc. The manufacturer does not recommend single-row applications; plan for head-to-head coverage. Do not reduce the radius below 5.2 m; adjust within the stated range.

Rain Bird R-VAN-24 создаёт несколько направленных вращающихся струй для равномерного полива газона. Более крупные капли лучше сохраняют траекторию при лёгком ветре, а согласованная интенсивность полива упрощает сочетание моделей серии.
Практические преимущества
Диапазон радиуса: 5,2–7,3 м.
Форма полива: регулируемый сектор 45°–270°.
Многопоточные струи создают более крупные капли, которые меньше отклоняются при лёгком ветре.

Рабочее давление: 2,1–3,8 бар; рекомендуемое: 3,1 бар. Для лучших результатов используйте корпус Rain Bird с регулятором давления PRS45.

en.description:

R-VAN nozzles are useful for matching irrigation coverage to the shape of the planting area, including standard arcs and narrow strips. Actual radius and uniformity depend on pressure, spacing, soil and wind conditions.

Радиус можно точно отрегулировать винтом. Выбирайте форсунку с учётом корпуса дождевателя, требуемого покрытия и расхода воды в зоне.

en.description:
Rain Bird R-VAN-14F is a rotary nozzle designed to deliver controlled, water-efficient irrigation for landscaped areas. Multiple rotating streams apply water more slowly than many conventional spray nozzles, helping the soil absorb it and reducing runoff when the system is correctly designed. The stated coverage is 2.4–4.3 m; the watering pattern is 360°; recommended operating pressure is 2.1–3.8 bar.

R-VAN nozzles are useful for matching irrigation coverage to the shape of the planting area, including standard arcs and narrow strips. Select the pattern to suit the location and maintain compatible pressure and flow. Use with compatible Rain Bird 1800/RD1800 spray bodies or other approved bodies as specified by the manufacturer.

Actual radius and uniformity depend on pressure, spacing, soil and wind conditions.

children.text: Rain Bird R-VAN-14F — multi-stream rotary nozzle

Rain Bird R-VAN-14F produces multiple rotating streams for even lawn irrigation. Larger droplets hold their trajectory better in light wind, while matched precipitation makes it easier to combine models from the series.
Practical benefits
Radius range: 2.4–4.6 m.
Pattern: fixed 360° full-circle pattern.
Multiple rotating streams create larger droplets that are less affected by light wind.
Matched precipitation makes it easier to combine different models in one system.
Adjustment, pressure and compatibility

Adjust the radius and arc by hand while the system is running; no special tool is required. To flush the nozzle, pull it upwards as directed by the manufacturer. Operating pressure: 2.1–3.8 bar; recommended: 3.1 bar. For best results, use a Rain Bird PRS45 pressure-regulated spray body.
Technical specifications
Model: R-VAN-14F; series: R-VAN.
Radius range: 2.4–4.6 m.
Arc/pattern: fixed 360° full-circle pattern; operating pressure: 2.1–3.8 bar; recommended: 3.1 bar.

At the recommended pressure of 3.1 bar, the radius is 4.3 m and flow is 4.81 l/min for the fixed 360° full-circle pattern. The manufacturer does not recommend single-row applications; plan for head-to-head coverage. Do not reduce the radius below 2.4 m; adjust within the stated range.
Delivery and service

Несколько вращающихся струй подают воду медленнее, чем многие обычные веерные форсунки, что помогает почве впитывать влагу и снижает сток при правильно спроектированной системе. Указанный радиус — 2.4–4.3 m; форма полива — 360°; рекомендуемое рабочее давление — 2.1–3.8 bar.

Выбирайте рисунок полива по расположению зоны и соблюдайте требования к давлению и расходу. Используются с совместимыми корпусами Rain Bird 1800/RD1800 или другими корпусами, разрешёнными производителем.

Фактический радиус и равномерность зависят от давления, расстояния между дождевателями, типа почвы и ветра.

children.text: Rain Bird R-VAN-14F — многопоточная роторная форсунка

Многопоточные струи создают более крупные капли, которые меньше отклоняются при лёгком ветре.

children.text: Rain Bird HE-VAN-12 — high-efficiency adjustable fan-spray nozzle

Benefits in the irrigation zone
Radius 3.0–3.7 m; arc undefined.

children.text: Rain Bird 15-LCS — дюза за лява ъглова ивица

children.text: Rain Bird R-VAN-LCS — rotary nozzle for a left-corner strip

Practical benefits
Pattern: left-corner strip.
Nominal coverage dimensions: 1.5 × 4.6 m at 2.4–3.4 bar. Dimensions vary with pressure: 1.2 × 4.3 m at 2.1 bar and 1.8 × 4.9 m at 3.8 bar.
